svg.title: Streaming MoE experts from the SSD through a device cache
svg.desc: For one layer and one token, the router picks 10 of 512 experts. Eight are already in the expert cache and two are read from the SSD into free cache slots. The experts then run on the GPU from the cache slots. While the GPU computes, the SSD reads one guessed expert for the next layer.
svg.text: ~1.75 MB each, one read per expert
1. The router picks 10 of 512 experts for this layer.
2. Eight are already cached (hits). Two misses are read from the SSD into free slots.
3. All ten run on the GPU, straight from the cache slots.
4. Meanwhile the SSD reads one guessed expert for the next layer; it enters the cache only if used.
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: 48 MoE layers × 512 experts, 10 active per token. Illustrative, slowed down.
